title: First time singing with the band: 'You're Driving Me Crazy'
summary: After pestering the bandleader he sang 'You're Driving Me Crazy' at the Backbiters Club, got applause and became a singer.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: bring it back, set the pitcher up on the bar, and I was through till they needed some more. But, still, I'm still workin' on this singin' bit, so I asked the cat, "Let me sing" again.
So I kept buggin' him so much that he says, "Well, come on, you can try. You can sing. You can get up there and make a fool out of you...outa yourself. And us, too!"
Say, "No," so I gonna play "You Drivin' Me Crazy."

Never will forget it. I hadda learn all the words. So they played "You're Drivin' Me Crazy." So I started singing. People got up and started dancing. So I got through. I got a round o' applause. Then on, I was a singer.
I took my time, and I learnt different songs to sing and everything. I was really cool.
What was the name of that club?
The Backbiters Club. So George Stone had died, and the dago had took it over. I suppose he was workin' for them in the first place.
